mapper.select: SELECT tt.* FROM ( SELECT ccc.TIMES, ccc.CONTRACT_ID, ccc.DUE_DATE AS FIN_INCOME_DATE, sum(case when ccc.cf_direction='INFLOW' THEN ccc.due_amount ELSE ccc.due_amount*-1 END) due_amount, sum(case when ccc.cf_direction='INFLOW' and ccc.cf_item=1 THEN ccc.interest when ccc.cf_direction='INFLOW' THEN ccc.due_amount ELSE ccc.due_amount*-1 END) finance_income FROM ( SELECT ccc.CONTRACT_ID, ccc.cf_item, ccc.cf_type, ccc.cf_direction, ccc.times, nvl(ccc.due_date,ccc.fin_income_date) due_date, ccc.due_amount, ccc.interest, ccc.cf_status FROM con_contract_cashflow ccc ) ccc WHERE ccc.CONTRACT_ID = #{contractId} AND ccc.cf_item IN (0,1, 11, 2, 3, 51) AND ccc.cf_status = 'RELEASE' GROUP BY ccc.times, ccc.CONTRACT_ID, ccc.due_date ORDER BY ccc.DUE_DATE ) tt order by tt.FIN_INCOME_DATE

SELECT min( gcc.times ) FROM gld_contract_cashflow gcc WHERE gcc.fin_income_date > ( SELECT max( fi.end_date ) FROM gld_contract_finance_income fi WHERE fi.post_flag = 'Y' AND fi.contract_id = #{contractId} ) AND gcc.contract_id = #{contractId}
SELECT sum(ccc.interest) interest FROM con_contract_cashflow ccc WHERE ccc.cf_item in(1,3) and ccc.contract_id = #{contractId}
SELECT nvl(sum(ccc.due_amount),0) due_amount FROM con_contract_cashflow ccc WHERE ccc.cf_item=3 and ccc.contract_id = #{contractId}

SELECT nvl(sum(case when ccc.cf_direction='INFLOW' THEN ccc.due_amount ELSE ccc.due_amount*-1 END),0) due_amount FROM con_contract_cashflow ccc WHERE ccc.cf_item in(52) and ccc.contract_id = #{contractId}

SELECT -nvl(sum(case when ccc.cf_direction='INFLOW' THEN ccc.due_amount ELSE ccc.due_amount*-1 END),0) due_amount FROM con_contract_cashflow ccc WHERE ccc.cf_item in(51) and ccc.contract_id = #{contractId}

SELECT tt.* FROM ( SELECT ccc.TIMES, ccc.CONTRACT_ID, ccc.DUE_DATE AS FIN_INCOME_DATE, sum(case when ccc.cf_direction='INFLOW' THEN ccc.due_amount ELSE ccc.due_amount*-1 END) due_amount, sum(case when ccc.cf_direction='INFLOW' and ccc.cf_item=1 THEN ccc.interest when ccc.cf_direction='INFLOW' THEN ccc.due_amount ELSE ccc.due_amount*-1 END) finance_income FROM ( SELECT ccc.CONTRACT_ID, ccc.cf_item, ccc.cf_type, ccc.cf_direction, ccc.times, nvl(eq.due_date,ccc.due_date) due_date, ccc.due_amount, ccc.interest, ccc.cf_status FROM con_contract_cashflow ccc left join ( SELECT nvl(ccc.full_write_off_date,nvl(ccc.due_date,ccc.fin_income_date)) due_date,times,contract_id FROM con_contract_cashflow ccc WHERE cf_item = 0 ) eq on eq.times = ccc.times and eq.contract_id = ccc.contract_id ) ccc WHERE ccc.CONTRACT_ID = #{contractId} AND ccc.cf_item IN (0,1, 11, 2, 3, 51) AND ccc.cf_status = 'RELEASE' GROUP BY ccc.times, ccc.CONTRACT_ID, ccc.due_date ORDER BY ccc.DUE_DATE ) tt order by tt.FIN_INCOME_DATE
